dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested time slot is full, the order is moved to the next open slot. It only confirms where there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) will still need to be confirmed.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the “Add order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Show one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Best for long menus, where each item stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Show all items in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — you scroll to move around. Best for short menus, where you can see most of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can place it now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Show a “Mark ready” button on the order screen. The kitchen screen (KDS) is set separately. Customers are sent an email whenever an order is marked ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer list as soon as you place an order, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. If it is off you can still add a buzzer any time by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful where you hand out buzzers, and easy to switch off where you don’t.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Switch this off when there is a card problem, and customers will place orders as normal and pay at the food truck instead. Orders keep coming in; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck, on every event, and stays off until you switch it on again.
dashboard.settings.soundsHelp: The on/off button is on each screen; each device controls its own sound.
